correctness.rationale: Every nonhub positive-indegree orientation has an exact +^a-^(ell-a) petal code. Necessity of the hub, forced internal predecessors, sharp cyclic/noncyclic costs, and the single hub-predecessor choice establish gamma_t=b+c and the local optimum counts for all lengths >=3. Independent brute-force checks of 14 profiles/424 valid orientations match both full polynomials.
